# Business Manager - Setup Instructions

## Quick Start (Recommended)

1. **Double-click BusinessManager.bat**
   - This will start the Business Manager app
   - Opens automatically at http://localhost:3000

## Requirements

- **Node.js** installed (download from https://nodejs.org/)
  - The .bat script will automatically install dependencies first time
  - Then opens the app in your browser

## First Run

1. Run BusinessManager.bat
2. Wait for "Business Manager running at http://localhost:3000"
3. Browser opens automatically
4. Follow the business setup wizard

## Accessing the App

- Browser: http://localhost:3000
- The app works only when the .bat script is running
- Press Ctrl+C in the command window to stop

## Support

- All data is saved in the data/ folder (local to the app)
- No internet required after first run
- Everything runs on your computer

## Known Requirements

- Windows 7 or later
- Node.js installed (free, 300MB)
- No admin privileges required
